checks.name: Passenger information
checks.observation: Soul effects and counterpart status stayed visible during boarding, routes and delivery.

checks.name: Preview and Back
checks.observation: Changed passengers and returned from a plan without spending a memory or moving the clocks.

checks.name: Reload and resume
checks.observation: Reloading a reviewed crossing preserved the pending plan.

checks.name: Matching deliveries
checks.observation: Matching and select-everyone controls produced the expected rewards; multiple matches restored only one light.

checks.name: Killer and event
checks.observation: Merciful Current set base fog to zero but Killer still drained one light.

checks.name: Memory use and cap
checks.observation: Light capped at six; fog memories changed the preview; hand overflow required a chosen discard.

checks.name: Calm target
checks.observation: A calming memory required a waiting target; selection could be changed before committing.

checks.name: Family quest
checks.observation: Mother and Child matched together unlocked Passage; sending Achilles added one wish and no light or memory.

checks.name: Sanctuary
checks.observation: Any wish matched; no light or memory reward; later final return still required payment.

checks.name: Winning ending
checks.observation: Four survived returns ended the night with eight wishes.

checks.name: Last-chance warning
checks.observation: Killer at outward move two displayed a last delivery warning.

checks.name: Zero light and Ship Wraith
checks.observation: The second crossing survived at exactly zero; leaving Killer aboard created one Ship Wraith.

checks.name: Known losing move
checks.observation: Return preview warned of one fog with zero light; explicit acceptance ended before arrival or tide advance.

checks.name: Help
checks.observation: Opened the guide dialog and closed it.

checks.name: New Night cancel
checks.observation: Keep current night preserved the winning game.

checks.observation: Starting seed one reset the isolated test game.
